card.name: Stopped therapy in hepatitis B warnings
card.fires_on: Mainly the word "discontinued" in the boxed warning about hepatitis B flares in patients with HIV-1 and HBV who have stopped lamivudine, tenofovir or emtricitabine products. It also fires weakly on a few other words in warning text.
